descriptor.retrieval_description: Smooth organic pear fruit with a slightly glossy, dry skin and continuous curved profile. The intended contact region is clean and smooth with gentle convex curvature across the lower body.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing flanks of the lower bulbous section of the pear
descriptor.local_geometry: Convex, smooth curvature with tapering toward the stem end
descriptor.uncertainty: Lighting reflections create minor glare spots on the surface, but the overall skin texture and geometry remain clearly discernible.
